title: Parse an inclusive range
description: The parser must accept equal endpoints and reject reversed endpoints.
diff:
diff --git a/range.py b/range.py
--- a/range.py
+++ b/range.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def valid(start, end):
-    return start <= end
+    return start < end

gold_findings.summary: The caller does not surface the validation error.
